blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Почему академики ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) двойную жизнь?
exercises.why: **ведут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: Why do academics have a double life?

exercises.q: Альфа-частицы ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) положительный заряд.
exercises.why: **несут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Alpha particles carry a positive charge.

exercises.q: Если ты мужчина, ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., imper. sg.) себя по-мужски.
exercises.why: **веди** — imperative (ты, singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: If you're a man, act like a man.

exercises.q: Какую обувь вы ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **носите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Почему ты ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) бедж?
exercises.why: **носишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
exercises.prompt: Why are you wearing a name tag?

exercises.q: Ты давно ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) линзы?
exercises.why: **носишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
exercises.prompt: Since when are you wearing contacts?

exercises.q: Медоеды обычно ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) ночной образ жизни.
exercises.why: **ведут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Какую обувь ты ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **носишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Медсёстры ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) белое.
exercises.why: **носят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Лейла не ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) хиджаб.
exercises.why: **носила** — past tense (feminine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Туземцы ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) мокасины.
exercises.why: **носят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Том ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) шейный бандаж.
exercises.why: **носил** — past tense (masculine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
exercises.prompt: Tom was wearing a neck brace.

exercises.q: Она учила меня ___ (водить — to lead, take along, there and back or in general; impf., inf.).
exercises.why: **водить** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: вести).
exercises.prompt: She taught me how to drive.

exercises.q: Кошки не ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) ошейники.
exercises.why: **носят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Она ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) атласный халат.
exercises.why: **носила** — past tense (feminine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
exercises.prompt: She was wearing a gown of satin.

exercises.q: Он ___ (водить — to lead, take along, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) электромобиль.
exercises.why: **водит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of водить: many-directions verb (one direction: вести).

exercises.q: Он ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) роскошные одежды.
exercises.why: **носил** — past tense (masculine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Все французы ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) береты.
exercises.why: **носят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Том ___ (водить — to lead, take along, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) черный пикап.
exercises.why: **водит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of водить: many-directions verb (one direction: вести).
exercises.prompt: Tom drives a black pick-up truck.

exercises.q: ___ (водить — to lead, take along, there and back or in general; impf., imper. sg.) машину осторожно.
exercises.why: **води** — imperative (ты, singular) of водить: many-directions verb (one direction: вести).
